message.title: STOREBRAND BANK ASA - SALE AND BUYBACK OF BONDS
message.body:
Storebrand Bank ASA announces that it has sold bonds nominal value of NOK 1000
million in the loan STORK17 (ISIN NO0010936917) and has acquired bonds with a
nominal value of NOK 1000 million in the loan STORK19 (ISIN NO0012526211). Both
bond issues are issued by Storebrand Boligkreditt AS.

Contact person:

Einar Leikanger. Head of Treasury T: +47 934 20379
